actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.role: Senator of Brazil and defeated presidential candidate
actors.blurb: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro remains at the center of intense international and domestic reporting following his flight from Brazil to Florida after losing the presidential election. His escape—allegedly aided by a former Mossad agent—has triggered lawsuits to suspend his congressional salary, Supreme Court money laundering inquiries, and political fallout both within Brazil and in US-Brazil diplomatic relations.

Meanwhile, his decision to allow exiled Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro to stay in the United States and ongoing foreign policy tensions surrounding Iran keep him central to global news.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: President Javier Milei continues to dominate news in Argentina as he prepares for an international trip to Madrid for the Ibero-American Summit and coordinates with local officials ahead of Pope Leo XIV's upcoming visit. His administration faces domestic legislative hurdles over the national budget and electoral reforms while navigating regional political shifts following the Brazilian election.

actors.name: Karol Nawrocki
actors.blurb: President Karol Nawrocki is at the epicenter of Poland's escalating constitutional crisis following his forceful entry into the Constitutional Tribunal alongside supporters. His actions have drawn severe criticism from Prime Minister Donald Tusk's government, sparked EU monitoring, and provoked reactions from international right-wing figures such as Marine Le Pen.

actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.role: Presidential Candidate and Leader of Rassemblement National
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen is generating widespread media coverage as polling shows increasing support from former Macron voters ahead of the 2027 French presidential election. She has also weighed into European affairs by publicly condemning the constitutional tribunal crisis in Poland, while facing legal uncertainty regarding her eligibility as the Cour de cassation considers her appeal.
